create_config_transformer: create a DoConfig dataclass to define transformer decoder-only hyper-parameters like dim, heads, layers, and vocab size
build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDo decoder-only model with embedding, positional encoding, causal attention blocks, and output logits
implement_causal_attention: implement a CausalAttn layer with query-key-value projections, scaled dot-product attention, and causal masking
define_transformer_block: define a TBlock transformer block with pre-layer norm, causal attention, residual connection, MLP feed-forward, and residual addition
construct_mlp_layer: construct an Mlp multilayer perceptron with two dense layers, GELU activation, and configurable inner dimension
